marketing_wrapper: Very heavy. Each frame has a saturated flat backdrop (electric blue, butter yellow/orange, periwinkle/lilac, lilac/green, pink/mint, yellow) covered in a pixel-mosaic dither pattern, with a heavy lowercase grotesk caption. 01 is a collage: three phones, two large anime-style character illustrations, a '#1 ai chat app' headline and a '100M+ trusted downloads' laurel badge, so real UI is under ~30%. 02–06 show one dark-bezel phone each with ~55–60% real UI. The UI inside is dark and fairly plain; most of the colour and the pixel motif belong to the wrapper. The status bar shows 3:19 and pre-iOS 26 chrome, so these may be older captures.

typography.display: In-app: a geometric-leaning sans, medium/semibold for headers ('Create Character', 'Memory Usage', 'For You'); the '(c.ai)' and '(character.ai)' wordmarks use parentheses as a brand device. Captions: heavy lowercase grotesk with tight tracking (marketing only)
typography.body: unsure: a geometric-leaning sans, not SF; roleplay narration is set in italic
typography.weights: Semibold card titles and headers; regular body and descriptions; italic for character narration in chat
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence case in-app; lowercase wordmark; marketing captions all lowercase and tightly tracked

palette.accent_strategy: Per-content: the UI chrome is neutral dark grey and white, and colour comes from character art, user-set chat backgrounds and the memory bar's category colours (yellow, cyan, pink, plum). The only fixed UI colour is the red End-call button. The saturated brand colours (blue #2462ec, yellow #fee600) sit in the marketing backdrops, not the UI.
palette.source: palette.json 06: #121213 36% = app canvas, #fee600 32% = marketing backdrop; 01 #2462ec 30% = marketing blue; 02 #fff59e / #daa856 = marketing yellow/orange. Pixel samples: canvas #131313 and card #1d1d1d (06), list rows #1e1e1e (03), End button #ff1f53 (04). Memory-bar colours are visual estimates from 03.

shape.radius_language: large and pill: character cards ~16pt with image tops, list rows ~12pt, filter chips and buttons full pill, chat bubbles ~20pt, circular call buttons
shape.borders_shadows: Outlined pill filter chips (unselected) with a white filled selected chip; no shadows
shape.materials: Flat dark surfaces; translucent grey chat bubbles over a user-chosen background image (05)

liquid_glass_visible: no: opaque dark chrome and a standard tab bar; the screenshots look pre-iOS 26.
density: medium-high: 2-column character grid with image, title, two-line description, chat count and creator handle; memory list rows with dots
layout: Home: '(c.ai)' wordmark, filter chip row (Creative, Fantasy, Gaming, Lifestyle…), 2-column character card grid. For You (01): full-bleed vertical character post with 'Continue this moment in chat', creator row, caption and reaction chips with counts. Chat (05): character header, user and character bubbles with avatars, over a custom illustrated background. Memory (03): usage bar plus category list.
navigation: Five-icon bottom tab bar, icons only (home filled, chat, '+' create, a library/card icon, profile avatar). Top bar has wordmark plus a 'C' badge, search and bell. Back chevrons on sub-screens. Chat header carries book, waveform and phone-call icons. Voice call is a full-screen view with minimise and overflow.
imagery_and_icons: Character art (anime and painterly illustration, much of it AI-generated) is the dominant imagery; outline monoline icons for chrome; avatars everywhere; the pixel-mosaic motif appears only in the marketing backdrops.
signature_visual_move: The UI steps back to neutral dark grey so each character's art and the user's chosen chat background supply all the colour.
tells_present: Cards everywhere; 'icon top-right, title top-left, description bottom' anatomy
Flat React Native or Flutter UI that ignores Liquid Glass on iOS 26

direction_fit.why: A For You vertical feed with reaction counts is visible (01), confirming the feed graft. The 'Character-Led' half of the text tag does not fit the 17's Coach Character: there is no single mascot state machine; instead user-made characters and user-set backgrounds carry the expression while the chrome stays plain, which is the User-Authored Poster pattern.

notes: Composer: a dark pill with the user's persona avatar at left, 'Message…', image and sticker buttons inside, and a separate circular fast-forward (skip/continue) button; below it a disclaimer 'This is A.I. and not a real person. Treat everything it says as fiction'. Greeting/empty state: not shown. Voice: modelled as a phone call (04) — the character's art full-bleed, 'Listening…' label, and three bottom controls: Mute (grey circle), the character's avatar with a white waveform overlay in the centre, and a red End circle; no orb. Thinking/streaming: not shown; a small speaker chip sits above character replies for TTS. Conversation list: not shown (the chat tab exists). The text record's complaint about raw persona text in list rows cannot be checked from these images; the home grid shows short descriptions truncated at two lines. Distinctiveness is scored mainly on the character art and backdrops; the UI alone would score 2.
